content: Digital gift card redemption flow must-haves: unique token/code with 16+ chars of entropy (wrappedgiftcards.com), single-use enforcement (idempotent claim), server-side validation before payment, rate limiting on redemption endpoint, expiration check, balance display before claim, clear success/failure feedback. For Lightning specifically: LNURL-w pull model (recipient wallet pulls, issuer pushes) vs BOLT11 push model (recipient provides invoice). LNURL-w is simpler for non-technical recipients (scan QR → any compatible wallet pulls). BOLT11 requires recipient to already have wallet and generate invoice. Guest path: LNBits creates instant wallet on scan of LNURL-w if no wallet exists.
